prediction.sql: WITH frpm_calc AS (SELECT frpm.CDSCode, frpm."County Name" AS County, frpm."School Name" AS "School Name", frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS FreeMealCount, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS TotalEnrollment, frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS FreeRate FROM frpm WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), ranked AS (SELECT frpm_calc.CDSCode, frpm_calc.County, frpm_calc."School Name", frpm_calc.FreeMealCount, frpm_calc.TotalEnrollment, frpm_calc.FreeRate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY frpm_calc.County ORDER BY frpm_calc.FreeRate DESC) AS CountyRank FROM frpm_calc), county_avg AS (SELECT frpm_calc.County, AVG(frpm_calc.FreeRate) AS CountyAverageFreeRate FROM frpm_calc GROUP BY frpm_calc.County) SELECT ranked.County AS County, ranked."School Name" AS "School Name", ranked.FreeRate AS HighestFreeRate, ranked.FreeMealCount AS FreeMealCount, ranked.TotalEnrollment AS TotalEnrollment, CASE schools.Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS IsCharterSchool, schools.GSserved AS GradesServed, CASE WHEN satscores.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR satscores.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR satscores.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS SATPerformance, county_avg.CountyAverageFreeRate AS CountyAverageFreeRate, ranked.FreeRate - county_avg.CountyAverageFreeRate AS DeviationFromCountyAverage FROM ranked JOIN schools ON schools.CDSCode = ranked.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode AND satscores.rtype = 'S' JOIN county_avg ON county_avg.County = ranked.County WHERE ranked.CountyRank = 1 ORDER BY ranked.FreeRate DESC LIMIT 1
